chinese_source: Jiu Tang shu / Xin Tang shu, Tianzhu accounts
event: Harsha ('king of Magadha') sends an embassy to Taizong; the Tang reply mission under Li Yibiao with Wang Xuance is in India 643-645; Xuanzang received at Harsha's court, Kannauj assembly 643
firmness_reason: Court annal record of received embassies, reign-era dated at every step
references: Jiu Tang shu / Xin Tang shu, Tianzhu zhuan

chinese_source: Tang annals and the excerpted remains of Wang Xuance's account
event: Wang Xuance's second mission (dispatched 647) finds Harsha dead and a usurper (Arunasva) enthroned; Wang defeats and captures the usurper in 648 with Tibetan and Nepalese troops
firmness_reason: Annalistic sequence; only the usurper's name/identity is Probable. No Indian source dates Harsha's death at all
notes: Campaign case 8 (calibration) verdict CORRECTED: death 647; with the Indian accession (606) gives the two-sided reign bracket [606, 647]. Cf. spine C22.
references: Levi, Les missions de Wang Hiuan-ts'e
